jobs.title: Commercial Skilling Manager
jobs.description:
Overview
 Be part of a culture that celebrates excellence and drives innovation where success is a shared journey.
 As a Commercial Skilling Manager within The Global Skilling (GS) team, you will join a group dedicated to shaping the future of technical skills enablement and measurable business impact worldwide. The Global Skilling team is learner obsessed, building an enthusiastic learning culture and driving strategic initiatives that accelerate Microsoft’s growth as a Cloud and AI leader. In this role, you will develop and execute skilling plans empowering the global workforce and reaching new learners—especially those in emerging roles and evolving industries—ensuring they are equipped to thrive in the AI era.
 You will collaborate with sales teams and internal stakeholders to ensure skilling and enablement are key differentiators in customer adoption of Microsoft platforms. Your expertise will be critical to helping customers accelerate digital transformation, achieve their business outcomes, and succeed on their AI journey. Join us to guide customers and partners, enabling them to build the essential technical skills that drive business results.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate with Customers: Work closely with customers to analyze their skilling needs and create comprehensive skilling plans focused on AI and Microsoft technologies. Align skilling solutions with strategic business goals to accelerate adoption and transformation.

• Customer Relationship Building: Cultivate relationships with customers throughout their AI journey. Engage with C-suite and stakeholders to demonstrate the value of skilling and translate business requirements into actionable strategies.

• Pipeline Management: Maintain a robust pipeline of skilling opportunities to support our business. Regularly forecast and track skilling engagements , ensuring they are aligned with the strategic priorities of field sales teams and customer needs. Proactively communicate status and adjust plans to meet demand.

• Orchestrate Resources for Execution: Execute skilling plans by orchestrating resources across digital platforms, training partners, and Microsoft trainers . Ensure excellence in execution by driving consistency, quality, and impact across delivery motions.

• Strategic Insights and Thought Leadership: Provide thought leadership on developing technical capabilities within our customer base. Your vision should emphasize scalable and high-impact skilling approaches .

• Effective Communication: Bridge technical and business audiences. Clearly articulate the value of AI skilling and adapt communication styles to resonate across diverse stakeholder groups.

• Innovation and Opportunity Development: Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and market demands. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to pilot novel learning initiatives that enhance AI adoption and drive organizational growth.

Qualifications

• Master's Degree or equivalent AND/
• OR several years experience in Learning and Development, relevant technical roles, business development, quota management, human resources (HR), customer success, collection management, research/restoration evaluation, industry, or program/project management

• OR Vocational qualification or higher education degree (e.g., Bachelor's Degree) AND/

• OR several years experience in Learning and Development, relevant technical roles, business development, field or sales, HR, customer success, collection management, research/restoration evaluation, industry, or program/project management

• OR equivalent experience.

• Fluency in both German and English required
 Additional or Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with Microsoft offerings (products and cloud and AI services), processes, and tools preferred along with prior experience in crafting or delivering training across diverse technical domains.

• Experience in driving large-scale enablement programs , with a track record of meeting or exceeding skilling targets and business impact metrics.

• Demonstrated thought leadership in learning & development , such as developing new training content, implementing innovative learning tools, or contributing to industry forums on skilling.

• Proven ability to collaborate with stakeholders, both externally and internally. Demonstrated experience engaging with customer executives and cross-functional internal teams to drive initiatives forward.

• Communication skills , with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business benefits. Presentation, writing, and interpersonal skills are a needed as well.

• High adaptability and problem-solving ability , including navigating change, ambiguity and adjusting plans to meet evolving needs. Self-driven and effective in a remote/virtual team environment.

• A growth mindset with a passion for continuous learning, and a collaborative approach that aligns with Microsoft’s values of respect, integrity, and accountability.

Panoramica
Partecipa a una cultura che celebra l'eccellenza e guida l'innovazione dove il successo è un viaggio condiviso.
Come Commercial Skilling Manager all'interno del team Global Skilling (GS), si unirà a un gruppo dedicato a modellare il futuro delle competenze tecniche abilitazione e impatto commerciale misurabile in tutto il mondo. Il team Global Skilling è ossessionato dagli studenti, creando una cultura di apprendimento entusiasta e guidando iniziative strategiche che accelerano la crescita di Microsoft come leader Cloud e AI. In questo ruolo, svilupperai ed eseguirai piani di abilità che abilitano la forza lavoro globale e raggiungano nuovi studenti, in particolare quelli nei ruoli emergenti e nelle industrie in evoluzione, garantendo che siano attrezzati per prosperare nell'era dell'IA.
Potrai collaborare con i team di vendita e gli stakeholder interni per garantire competenze e abilitazione sono differenziatori chiave nell'adozione dei clienti di piattaforme Microsoft. La vostra esperienza sarà fondamentale per aiutare i clienti ad accelerare la trasformazione digitale, raggiungere i loro risultati aziendali, e avere successo nel loro viaggio AI. Unisciti a noi per guidare clienti e partner, consentendo loro di costruire le competenze tecniche essenziali che guidano i risultati aziendali.
La missione di Microsoft è di consentire a ogni persona e ogni organizzazione del pianeta di ottenere di più. Come dipendenti ci uniamo con una mentalità di crescita, innovare per potenziare gli altri, e collaborare per realizzare i nostri obiettivi condivisi. Ogni giorno costruiamo sui nostri valori di rispetto, integrità e responsabilità per creare una cultura di inclusione dove tutti possono prosperare al lavoro e oltre.

responsabilità

• Collaborare con i clienti: lavorare a stretto contatto con i clienti per analizzare le loro esigenze di abilità e creare piani di abilità completi focalizzati sulle tecnologie AI e Microsoft. Allineare le soluzioni di abilità con obiettivi strategici di business per accelerare l'adozione e la trasformazione.

• Customer Relationship Building: Coltivare le relazioni con i clienti durante il loro viaggio AI. Impegnarsi con C-suite e gli stakeholder per dimostrare il valore di abilità e tradurre i requisiti aziendali in strategie attuabili.

• Pipeline Management: Mantenere una solida pipeline di opportunità di abilità per sostenere la nostra attività. Previsione regolare e monitoraggio degli impegni di abilità, assicurando che siano allineati con le priorità strategiche dei team di vendita sul campo e le esigenze dei clienti. Proattivamente comunicare lo stato e regolare i piani per soddisfare la domanda.

• Orchestrate Resources for Execution: Eseguire piani di abilità orchestrando risorse attraverso piattaforme digitali, partner di formazione e formatori Microsoft . Assicurare l'eccellenza nell'esecuzione guidando consistenza, qualità e impatto attraverso i movimenti di consegna.

• Strategic Insights and Thought Leadership: Fornire leadership pensiero per lo sviluppo di capacità tecniche all'interno della nostra base clienti. La tua visione dovrebbe enfatizzare approcci di abilità scalabili e ad alto impatto.

• Efficace comunicazione: Bridge pubblico tecnico e commerciale. Chiaramente articola il valore dell'intelligenza artificiale e adatta gli stili di comunicazione per risuonare attraverso diversi gruppi di stakeholder.

• Innovazione e Sviluppo dell'Opportunità: Rimani al passo con le tendenze del settore, le tecnologie emergenti e le richieste di mercato. Collabora con team interfunzionali per pilotare nuove iniziative di apprendimento che migliorano l'adozione dell'IA e spingono la crescita organizzativa.

Qualifiche

• Laurea magistrale o equivalente E/
• O più anni di esperienza nell'apprendimento e nello sviluppo, ruoli tecnici rilevanti, sviluppo aziendale, gestione delle quote, risorse umane (HR), successo del cliente, gestione della raccolta, valutazione della ricerca / restauro, industria, o gestione del programma / progetto

• O qualifica professionale o diploma di istruzione superiore (ad esempio, laurea di primo livello) E/

• O più anni di esperienza nell'apprendimento e nello sviluppo, ruoli tecnici rilevanti, sviluppo aziendale, campo o vendite, HR, successo del cliente, gestione della raccolta, valutazione di ricerca / restauro, industria, o gestione del programma / progetto

• O esperienza equivalente.

• Potenza necessaria sia in tedesco che in inglese
Qualificazioni aggiuntive o preferenziali

• Familiarità con le offerte Microsoft (prodotti e servizi cloud e AI), processi e strumenti preferiti insieme a una precedente esperienza nell'artigianato o nella formazione attraverso diversi domini tecnici.

• Esperienza nella guida di programmi di abilitazione su larga scala, con un track record di meeting o superiore obiettivi di abilità e metriche di impatto aziendale.

• Dimostrata leadership di pensiero nell'apprendimento e nello sviluppo, come lo sviluppo di nuovi contenuti di formazione, l'implementazione di strumenti di apprendimento innovativi, o contribuire a forum di industria su abilità.

• Prove capacità di collaborare con gli stakeholder, sia esternamente che internamente. Esperienza dimostrata impegnata con i dirigenti dei clienti e i team interni interfunzionali per portare avanti iniziative.

• Competenze di comunicazione , con la capacità di tradurre concetti tecnici complessi in chiari vantaggi aziendali. La presentazione, la scrittura e le competenze interpersonali sono anche necessarie.

• Alta capacità di adattamento e risoluzione dei problemi, tra cui la navigazione del cambiamento, l'ambiguità e la regolazione dei piani per soddisfare le esigenze in evoluzione. Autodidatta ed efficace in un ambiente di team remoto/virtuale.

• Una mentalità di crescita con una passione per l'apprendimento continuo, e un approccio collaborativo che si allinea con i valori di Microsoft di rispetto, integrità e responsabilità.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Übersicht
Seien Sie Teil einer Kultur, die Exzellenz feiert und Innovationen vorantreibt, bei denen Erfolg eine gemeinsame Reise ist.
Als Commercial Skilling Manager im Global Skilling (GS) Team treten Sie einer Gruppe bei, die sich der Gestaltung der Zukunft der technischen Fähigkeiten und der messbaren Geschäftsauswirkungen weltweit widmet. Das Global Skilling-Team ist besessen von Lernenden, baut eine begeisterte Lernkultur auf und treibt strategische Initiativen voran, die das Wachstum von Microsoft als führender Cloud- und KI-Manager beschleunigen. In dieser Rolle werden Sie Skilling-Pläne entwickeln und ausführen, die die globale Belegschaft stärken und neue Lernende erreichen - insbesondere in aufstrebenden Rollen und sich entwickelnden Branchen -, um sicherzustellen, dass sie in der KI-Ära erfolgreich sein können.
Sie arbeiten mit Vertriebsteams und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass Skilling und Enablement wichtige Unterscheidungsmerkmale bei der Kundenakzeptanz von Microsoft-Plattformen sind. Ihre Expertise wird entscheidend sein, um Kunden zu helfen, die digitale Transformation zu beschleunigen, ihre Geschäftsergebnisse zu erzielen und auf ihrer KI-Reise erfolgreich zu sein. Begleiten Sie uns, um Kunden und Partner zu führen und ihnen zu ermöglichen, die wesentlichen technischen Fähigkeiten aufzubauen, die die Geschäftsergebnisse vorantreiben.
Microsofts Mission ist es, jede Person und jedes Unternehmen auf dem Planeten zu befähigen, mehr zu erreichen. Als Mitarbeiter kommen wir mit einer Wachstumsmentalität zusammen, innovieren, um andere zu stärken, und arbeiten zusammen, um unsere gemeinsamen Ziele zu erreichen. Jeden Tag bauen wir auf unseren Werten Respekt, Integrität und Rechenschaftspflicht auf, um eine Kultur der Inklusion zu schaffen, in der jeder bei der Arbeit und darüber hinaus gedeihen kann.

Zuständigkeiten

• Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Kunden zusammen, um ihre Qualifikationsbedürfnisse zu analysieren und umfassende Qualifikationspläne zu erstellen, die sich auf KI- und Microsoft-Technologien konzentrieren. Skilling-Lösungen an strategischen Geschäftszielen ausrichten, um die Akzeptanz und Transformation zu beschleunigen.

• Customer Relationship Building: Pflegen Sie Beziehungen zu Kunden während ihrer gesamten KI-Reise. Engagieren Sie sich mit C-Suite und Stakeholdern, um den Wert der Qualifikation zu demonstrieren und Geschäftsanforderungen in umsetzbare Strategien umzusetzen.

• Pipeline Management: Pflegen Sie eine robuste Pipeline von Qualifikationsmöglichkeiten, um unser Geschäft zu unterstützen. Prognostizieren und verfolgen Sie regelmäßig Qualifikationsverpflichtungen und stellen Sie sicher, dass sie mit den strategischen Prioritäten der Außendienstteams und den Kundenbedürfnissen in Einklang stehen. Status proaktiv kommunizieren und Pläne an die Nachfrage anpassen.

• Orchestrieren Sie Ressourcen für die Ausführung: Führen Sie Skilling-Pläne aus, indem Sie Ressourcen über digitale Plattformen, Schulungspartner und Microsoft-Trainer orchestrieren. Stellen Sie Exzellenz in der Ausführung sicher, indem Sie Konsistenz, Qualität und Auswirkungen über Lieferbewegungen hinweg fördern.

• Strategische Einblicke und Thought Leadership: Vordenkerrolle bei der Entwicklung technischer Fähigkeiten in unserem Kundenstamm. Ihre Vision sollte skalierbare und hochwirksame Skilling-Ansätze betonen.

• Effektive Kommunikation: Brücke technische und Business-Publikum. Den Wert des KI-Skillings klar artikulieren und Kommunikationsstile anpassen, um über verschiedene Interessengruppen hinweg Resonanz zu finden.

• Innovation und Chancenentwicklung: Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über Branchentrends, neue Technologien und Marktanforderungen. Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um neuartige Lerninitiativen zu pilotieren, die die KI-Einführung verbessern und das organisatorische Wachstum vorantreiben.

Qualifikationen

• Master-Abschluss oder gleichwertig UND /
• ODER mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Lernen und Entwicklung, relevante technische Rollen, Geschäftsentwicklung, Quotenmanagement, Human Resources (HR), Kundenerfolg, Sammlungsmanagement, Forschung / Restaurierung Bewertung, Industrie oder Programm / Projektmanagement

• ODER Berufsqualifikation oder Hochschulabschluss (z. B. Bachelor-Abschluss) UND /

• ODER mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Lernen und Entwicklung, relevante technische Rollen, Geschäftsentwicklung, Feld oder Vertrieb, HR, Kundenerfolg, Sammlungsmanagement, Forschung / Restaurierung Bewertung, Industrie oder Programm / Projektmanagement

• Oder gleichwertige Erfahrung.

• Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch erforderlich
Zusätzliche oder bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• Vertrautheit mit Microsoft-Angeboten (Produkten und Cloud- und KI-Services), Prozessen und Tools, die bevorzugt werden, sowie vorherige Erfahrung in der Erstellung oder Bereitstellung von Schulungen in verschiedenen technischen Bereichen.

• Erfahrung in der Förderung groß angelegter Enablement-Programme mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Erreichung oder Überschreitung von Qualifikationszielen und Geschäftswirkungskennzahlen.

• Demonstrierte Vordenkerrolle im Bereich Lernen und Entwicklung, z. B. Entwicklung neuer Schulungsinhalte, Implementierung innovativer Lernwerkzeuge oder Beiträge zu Branchenforen zum Thema Skilling.

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern, sowohl extern als auch intern. Demonstrierte Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kundenmanagern und funktionsübergreifenden internen Teams, um Initiativen voranzutreiben.

• Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Konzepte in klare geschäftliche Vorteile zu übersetzen. Präsentation, Schreiben und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten sind ebenfalls erforderlich.

• Hohe Anpassungsfähigkeit und Problemlösungsfähigkeit, einschließlich der Navigation von Veränderungen, Mehrdeutigkeiten und der Anpassung von Plänen an sich ändernde Bedürfnisse. Selbstgesteuert und effektiv in einer Remote- / virtuellen Teamumgebung.

• Ein Wachstumsdenken mit einer Leidenschaft für kontinuierliches Lernen und einem kollaborativen Ansatz, der mit den Werten von Microsoft in Bezug auf Respekt, Integrität und Rechenschaftspflicht übereinstimmt.

Aperçu général
Faire partie d'une culture qui célèbre l'excellence et stimule l'innovation où le succès est un parcours partagé.
En tant que responsable des compétences commerciales au sein de l'équipe Global Skilling (GS), vous rejoindrez un groupe dédié à façonner l'avenir des compétences techniques et un impact commercial mesurable dans le monde entier. L'équipe Global Skilling est obsédée par l'apprenant, développant une culture d'apprentissage enthousiaste et conduisant des initiatives stratégiques qui accélèrent la croissance de Microsoft en tant que leader du Cloud et de l'IA. Dans ce rôle, vous élaborerez et exécuterez des plans de compétences qui responsabiliseront la main-d'oeuvre mondiale et toucheront de nouveaux apprenants, en particulier ceux qui occupent des rôles émergents et des industries en évolution, en veillant à ce qu'ils soient équipés pour prospérer à l'ère de l'IA.
Vous collaborerez avec les équipes de vente et les intervenants internes pour s'assurer que les compétences et l'activation sont des différenciateurs clés dans l'adoption des plateformes Microsoft par les clients. Votre expertise sera essentielle pour aider les clients à accélérer la transformation numérique, à atteindre leurs résultats commerciaux et à réussir leur parcours d'IA. Joignez-vous à nous pour guider les clients et les partenaires, leur permettant de développer les compétences techniques essentielles qui motivent les résultats commerciaux.
La mission de Microsoft est d'habiliter chaque personne et chaque organisation de la planète à réaliser davantage. En tant qu'employés, nous nous associons à une mentalité de croissance, innovons pour responsabiliser les autres et collaborons pour réaliser nos objectifs communs. Chaque jour, nous nous appuyons sur nos valeurs de respect, d'intégrité et de responsabilité pour créer une culture d'inclusion où chacun peut prospérer au travail et au-delà.

Responsabilités

jobs.description:
Overview
 As a Microsoft Data Center Project Manager (DCPM), you will perform troubleshooting for service incidents, manage assigned projects to meet service delivery objectives as well escalate to appropriate stakeholders to remove obstacles. You will also follow safety policies and procedures and participate in root cause analysis (RCA) of incidents. This job will allow you to build a solid understanding of data center procedures, engage in collaboration across various teams as well as provide mentorship across data centers by sharing best practices.
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCPM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
 Location: Geneva

• Coordination of both the deployment & the decommissioning of Data Center IT Equipment & Infrastructure, utilizing process knowledge and experience to ensure team meet associated OKRs.

• Follow and adhere to safety and security policies and procedures. Report immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.

• Contribute to troubleshooting for service incidents and escalates, as appropriate, to meet SLA/OLAs, with minimal disruption to the client/customer and business.

• Recognize potential customer impact of other events and issues (e.g., customer lockdown), communicate potential impact, and plan for impact accordingly.

• Proactively review schedules and avoid conflicts when possible. Identify, coordinate, manage expectations, and offer alternatives when defining customer solutions.

• Manage relationships with clients and suppliers to ensure that all expectations are clarified, understood, documented, and met.

• Suggest ways for reducing the risk of performing maintenance; work with others to accommodate scheduling needs.

• In alignment with management priorities, hold self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service). Support escalation of issues to appropriate owner.

• Embody our culture and values .

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications:

• High School Diploma or equivalent AND industry experience
• industry experience and college course work.

Background Check Requirements:
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

• Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
 While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU) or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling).

• Technical College degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or related field.

• Applicable certifications: ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA, Microsoft, Network Certifications, PMP, ITIL, CDCP.

Ce travail vous permettra de développer une compréhension solide des procédures des centres de données, d'engager une collaboration entre différentes équipes et de fournir un mentorat entre les centres de données en partageant les meilleures pratiques. Microsoft's Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) est le moteur qui alimente nos services cloud. En tant que CO+I DCP, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la fourniture de l'infrastructure de base et des technologies fondamentales pour les services en ligne de Microsoft, y compris Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive et la plateforme Microsoft Azure. Overview
 In the Microsoft Industry Solutions Engineering (ISE) team, you won’t just build software; you’ll deliver real outcomes for some of the world’s most complex organizations.

We are a global team of world-class engineers who have been working in a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model for more than a decade, embedding directly within customer teams to solve their toughest challenges, side-by-side, and shipping production-ready solutions in days, not months.

As a Principal Account-Aligned FDE , you will be a customer embedded engineer to serve as the primary technical leader aligned to a strategic account, driving business outcomes through hands on execution and multidisciplinary expertise. In this role, you will build and ship production grade solutions, work directly with customers to translate business needs into clear technical approaches, and operate with speed in complex, fast moving environments. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical depth, credibility with senior stakeholders, industry context, and an entrepreneurial approach to navigating ambiguity and delivering sustained impact over time.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Drive customer outcomes by shaping opportunities and translating business needs into clear, actionable technical approaches

• Build and deliver production-grade solutions in customer environments, demonstrating strong engineering execution and end-to-end ownership

• Accelerate time to value by operating effectively in ambiguity and delivering iterative, high-impact solutions

• Engage and influence senior stakeholders to build trust, align priorities, and guide technical and business decision-making

• Apply industry and customer context to tailor solutions and move beyond generic approaches

• Prepare and transition work to FDE crews with clear scope and strong technical direction, maintaining continuity across the engagement lifecycle

• Operate with an entrepreneurial mindset to navigate complex account dynamics, set boundaries, and drive urgency and accountability.

• Embody our culture and values .

Qualifications
 Required/Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

• Or equivalent experience

• 3+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.

• Experience partnering directly with customers or internal stakeholders to deliver solutions end-to-end.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications (PQs)

• Bachelor’s Degree AND 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

• OR product development

• 8+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.

• 2+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles (e.g., consulting, solutions engineering, field engineering, or similar).

• Experience with AI/ML technologies, cloud architecture, data engineering, and using AI tools and workflows in creating software engineering artifacts.

Overview
 As the Director, Solution Specialist Manager, AI Business Solutions , you will lead a globally distributed team of solution specialists spanning the Americas, EMEA, and Asia, focused on driving growth across AI Business Solutions, Security, and Business Process.

This role includes engagement with Japanese top enterprise customers as part of the Microsoft Japan subsidiary, while blending expert-level AI, business process, and security solutioning with exceptional people leadership and business management capabilities. A key expectation is to accelerate Frontier GTM/cross-solution area best practices, scale cross-geography learnings, and advance Microsoft’s Intelligence + Trust value proposition across regions and customer segments. You will coach and develop specialist teams, engage directly with strategic customers and partners, own forecast and execution discipline, and remove blockers to accelerate measurable business impact.

Operating at a highly visible global level, you will help shape strategy, represent the business to senior stakeholders across regions, and ensure the team delivers against revenue, customer transformation, and operational excellence goals in a complex, fast-moving AI and Security landscape.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
 Customer Engagement and Partnership

• Serves as a customer and partner advocate across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia, including Japanese top enterprise customers as part of the Microsoft Japan subsidiary, offering feedback to business and solution area leaders to refine strategy, encourage continuous improvement, seize market opportunities, and build trust.

• Encourages early engagement of strategic partners in the sales process to enhance customer adoption and accelerate value realization.

• Delivers insights and feedback to internal teams to improve go-to-market (GTM) strategies and execution. Guides the team in identifying and aligning sales plays with market, industry, and customer needs across AI Business Solutions, Security, and Business Process.

• Actively seeks to match solution scenarios with customer and partner organizations, focusing on how Microsoft’s offerings can complement and add value to business operations across complex regional, industry, and stakeholder environments.

• Acts as a trusted advisor to customers and partners, using expert-level solutioning and business insight to foster marketplace success.

• Advocates for customer support resources through Unified Support that help accelerate business value realization, transformation, and measurable impact.

People Management

• Delivering success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.

• Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles. Demonstrate inclusive, cross-cultural leadership across a globally distributed team.

• Coach: Define team objectives and measurable outcomes. Enable success across boundaries, regions, and solution areas. Help the team adapt, learn, and thrive in ambiguity.

• Care: Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others and build diverse leadership capacity across AI Business Solutions, Security, and Business Process.

Sales Operations and Pipeline Management

• Drives a clear operating rhythm to scale cross-solution area best practices and cross-geography learnings across AI Business Solutions, Security, and Business Process.

• Guides the team in using automation, AI-powered analytics, forecasting tools, and sales methodologies to strengthen pipeline quality and execution.

• Partners with area and organization leaders to manage pipeline health, identify stalled opportunities, remove blockers, and improve forecast accuracy.

• Aligns resources, capability development, and opportunity management to support revenue growth, customer commitments, and measurable business impact.

Sales Strategy and Execution

• Guides the team in identifying market trends, customer priorities, competitive threats, and industry opportunities across core solution areas.

• Develops and executes sales strategies that align AI, cloud, security, and business process solutions to customer transformation needs and total addressable market opportunities.

• Coaches the team to differentiate Microsoft’s offerings through expert solutioning, customer-specific value propositions, and the Intelligence + Trust narrative.

• Builds team resilience, innovation, and leadership depth to deliver measurable market impact across regions, industries, and complex stakeholder environments.

Qualifications

• Proven track record of delivering measurable business impact through strategic leadership, operational excellence, disciplined pipeline management, and customer-obsessed execution across complex solution portfolios.

• solutioning experience across AI Business Solutions, Security, and Business Process, with the ability to translate industry priorities into transformation opportunities

• Demonstrable experience in solution or services sales.

• Experience managing teams either through direct line management or matrix/project management.

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, Analytics, Data Science OR Master's Degree in Business Administration (i.e., MBA), Information Technology, Information Security OR equivalent experience.

While specific locations are highlighted, we are open to considering candidates from other locations across Europe based on business needs.
